answer.description: Tenant-facing message, or exactly NO_ANSWER when nothing should be sent to the tenant.

actions.description: Internal actions for the backend. Empty array when none.

why.description: 1-2 concise internal sentences explaining the decision. Never shown to the tenant.

review_answer.description: Only when answer is NO_ANSWER because staff already answered or are handling the topic: the reply you would have given if staff had not replied. Never sent to the tenant - managers read it to review the AI. Empty string otherwise.
